description: Deterministic schema for per-iteration issue/solution recording.

field_spec.issue_ids: Array of issue IDs from issue_solution_map.json
field_spec.evidence_refs: Array of deterministic source references (log lines, files, command outputs)
field_spec.changes: Array of changed files with concise what/why
field_spec.validation: Array of commands/checks and pass/fail status
field_spec.next_actions: Array of next validation or fix steps
